# 00000008559

**POS-29 ★** — source: 270_偏序集与格理论.md

**English.** Definition: The infinite distributive law for complete lattices. Conjecture: A complete lattice is completely distributive if and only if it is generated by complete chain products; and the smallest complete lattice failing complete distributivity is the dual of the three-element antichain construction. (complete distributivity chain product characterization)

**中文。** 定义：完备格的无限分配律。猜想：完备格满足完全分配 iff 它可由完全链积生成；非完全分配的最小完备格为三条反链的对偶。（完全分配链积刻画）
